name: login-form (validation-heavy happy+negative)
description_html:
Acceptance Criteria

  • User can sign in with a valid email and password
  • Wrong password shows an inline error
  • Account locks after 5 failed attempts

steps.action: Enter "user@example.com" and "Passw0rd!" then click Sign in
Enter "user@example.com" and "wrong-pass" then click Sign in
steps.expected_result: An inline error "Invalid credentials" is displayed
